scope: Focused text-only editorial DATA review of immutable source segments 1521–1600 (80 segments). All 317 source word occurrences are preserved in exact spelling and order: 277 eligible, 39 explicitly excluded nonspoken sound/action-description occurrences, and one excluded interrupted word at 1548:w02 doğ. The interrupted token is neither silently completed as doğramak nor taught as a complete birth/sunrise imperative; the three complete onion words remain eligible. All 277 eligible occurrences have Arabic-only contextual prompts, contextual explanations and four-option choice overrides. All excluded-row prompts are also Arabic-only. Fifteen segments have no eligible occurrences and are wholly non-educational; personal names in action descriptions remain eligible and explicitly marked as written, not claimed audible (Memo in 1537, 1539 and 1543; Askorozlu in 1545). Speaker names, the rank Teğmen and role asker attached to intelligible dialogue are retained. No unresolved spelling hold was identified; no source spelling was corrected. TDK-published linguistic evidence supports the colloquial vocative la and affectionate personal-name morphology in Ovacığım. The valid repeated converb baka baka, meaningful he/ha/ya, and the wish form olasın are retained. The source gloss for sefer at 1592 is corrected contextually to 'occasion/time', not the personal name Sefer. Context also distinguishes permissive Gel after a knock, the concession patterns derse desin/verirse versin/keserse kessin, future-as-instruction Unutmayacaksın, bir dur as a request to pause, dual-inclusive İkinizin de, and political Sağcılarla solcular. Allahümme inna sabirin is retained as the character's meaningful Arabic-derived utterance, with cautious lexical interpretation only: it is not certified as a standard Arabic prayer, standard Turkish morphology, or audiovisual transcription, and no missing words or corrected formula are invented. The primary Turkish commentary documents the borrowed invocation elements and warns about noncanonical formulas; it does not attest this entire exact film formula. The political, religious and mental-health descriptions and insult puşt are explained as dialogue, not endorsed. Reference URLs appear only in references metadata. No audiovisual verification, native-speaker certification, device acceptance, software execution, or full-film editorial acceptance is claimed.
